name: Pyrogarr the Crimson Bulwark

abilities.name: Pyroclastic Aegis
abilities.description: Unleashes a wave of molten armor, shielding all front-line infantry. Absorbs damage equivalent to 25% of the dragon's defense for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Spitfire Cleave
abilities.description: Infantry basic attacks have a 15% chance to splinter, dealing 50% splash damage to adjacent hostile squads.

description: Forged in the deepest lava springs of Emberfall, Pyrogarr's scales are as hard as core obsidian. He guards the vanguard with unyielding molten shields.

name: Sylvana the Galebreeze

abilities.name: Cyclone Eye
abilities.description: Summons a precise spiral gust that boosts Marksmen attack range by 15% and increases critical strike chance by 20% for 12 seconds.

abilities.name: Piercing Zephyr
abilities.description: Marksmen normal strikes bypass up to 12% of the opponent's raw armor defense stats.

description: Sylvana flows through the Wildwood canopy like a whisper, carrying the high arrows of Crownspire rangers directly to their targets' hearts.

name: Boreas the Swift-Glissade

abilities.name: Frostbite Charge
abilities.description: Creates an icy trail for cavalry charges, speeding up cavalry marches by 40% and freezing the enemy vanguard for 3 seconds upon contact.

abilities.name: Shattering Hooves
abilities.description: Gains a 10% damage bonus against frozen, slowed, or otherwise crowd-controlled enemy squads.

description: An ice-veined dragon from Frostborne Peak. Boreas channels sub-zero blizzards to clear rapid paths for steel-clad war steeds.

name: Terrageos the Lithic Titan

abilities.name: Tectonic Resonance
abilities.description: Unlocks magnetic resonance across the continent, instantly scanning and highlighting high-yield tier-8 resource veins for safety.

abilities.name: Crystalline Protection
abilities.description: While gathering from nodes, the deployed army is protected by a limestone shell, reducing casualty risk by 20% if ambushed.

description: A stone-scaled colossus whose steady, rhythmic footsteps soothe troubled ground, helping miners dredge up ore caches cleanly.

name: Ignis the Sovereign Overlord

abilities.name: Sovereign Command Aura
abilities.description: When hosting an Alliance Rally, increases total troop participation damage by 30% and nullifies mental fear or morale reduction debuffs.

abilities.name: Imperial Firestorm
abilities.description: Rally attacks sweep across the landscape, melting up to 15% of garrison towers' base fortress defensive wall durability.

description: The sacred dragon of Aurelia Palace, possessing majestic wings that command unconditional authority. He leads massive allied coalitions to absolute war victory.

name: Shadowfang the Behemoth Stalker

abilities.name: Slayer's Instinct
abilities.description: Scans world monsters for structural weakpoints, guaranteeing 100% Critical Strike on the first 3 attack rounds of combat.

abilities.name: Vitality Leach
abilities.description: Heals the marching army by 5% of all damage dealt exclusively when battling map monster nodes.

description: An elusive predator from Shadowvale Syndicate. Striking unseen from deep mist, it specializes in taking down massive behemoths with lethal accuracy.
